question: By the time the train left, we ___ for two hours.

explanation_ne: अर्को विगतको कार्यअघि जारी रहेको कार्यका लागि past perfect continuous प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: I ___ in Kathmandu since 2018.

question: Hardly ___ the station when the train arrived.

question: When I was a child, I ___ in the river every summer.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँमा सही विकल्प छान्नुहोस्: When I was a child, I ___ in the river every summer.
explanation: 'Used to' + base verb expresses a past habit.
explanation_ne: 'Used to' + मूल क्रियाले विगतको बानी जनाउँछ।

question: He ___ the book by tomorrow evening.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँमा सही विकल्प छान्नुहोस्: He ___ the book by tomorrow evening.
explanation: 'By tomorrow evening' points to a completed future action, so the future perfect is used.
explanation_ne: 'By tomorrow evening' ले भविष्यमा सकिने कार्य देखाउँछ, त्यसैले future perfect प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: The sun ___ in the east.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँमा सही विकल्प छान्नुहोस्: The sun ___ in the east.
explanation: Universal truths use the simple present.
explanation_ne: सार्वभौमिक सत्यका लागि simple present प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ the picnic.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँमा सही विकल्प छान्नुहोस्: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ the picnic.
explanation: A first conditional (real future possibility) uses 'will + base verb'.
explanation_ne: पहिलो सर्त (वास्तविक भविष्य सम्भावना) मा 'will + मूल क्रिया' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: If I were rich, I ___ a hospital in my village.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँमा सही विकल्प छान्नुहोस्: If I were rich, I ___ a hospital in my village.
explanation: A second conditional (unreal present) uses 'would + base verb'.
explanation_ne: दोस्रो सर्त (अवास्तविक वर्तमान) मा 'would + मूल क्रिया' प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: She said she ___ the report the previous day.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँमा सही विकल्प छान्नुहोस्: She said she ___ the report the previous day.
explanation: In reported speech, the past simple shifts back to the past perfect.
explanation_ne: परोक्ष कथनमा past simple past perfect मा सर्छ।

question: He asked me whether I ___ to Pokhara before.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँमा सही विकल्प छान्नुहोस्: He asked me whether I ___ to Pokhara before.

explanation_ne: परोक्ष प्रश्नमा present perfect past perfect मा सर्छ।

question: The letter ___ yesterday by the postman.

question: The bridge ___ by the end of next year.

explanation: A future perfect passive uses 'will have been + past participle'.

question: You ___ smoke in the hospital. It is strictly forbidden.

question: You ___ wear a helmet while riding a motorcycle; it is the law.

question: He ___ have missed the bus; that is why he is late.

explanation_ne: 'Must have + past participle' ले विगतबारे बलियो अनुमान जनाउँछ।

question: We ___ hurry; the exam starts in ten minutes.

question: Each of the boys ___ given a certificate.

question: The number of applicants ___ increasing every year.

question: The committee ___ divided on this issue.

question: I wish I ___ more time to finish this work.

question: She apologised ___ her mistake.
